manifest_description: Authoritative provenance and metadata for packaged OCR smoke test samples.
provenance_note: These 5 samples originate from the 500-sample validation set (runs/audit/subset_full/val_manifest.json) created for the ocr_handwriting_full training run. They are completely excluded from the 59,462 training samples. The original_rel_path values contain 'images/train/' because the upstream HuggingFace Viet-Handwriting-OCR-v2 archive stored its raw extracted parquet files in that directory structure prior to the project's train/validation partitioning.
authoritative_split: VALIDATION (5-sample subset of frozen 500-sample validation set)
metric_classification: Mean CER on the 5 packaged smoke-test samples (NOT official validation CER and NOT production accuracy)
